name: A coordinator role and personal-agent grant for approvals and the web merge slot
aliases: take and release the merge slot
summary: Coordinator roles and personal-agent grants supply reviews.approve and coordinate while the account holds them; worker credentials do not. Agents never approve their own party. The endpoint table binds action/operation to capability and project; a carried block for an absent action/operation is refused before action locks, reservation or effects. The preceding worker namespace check may read registry/native rows. Nontext capabilities refuse403, and forged review help/list attachments reserve nothing. No-block host calls retain their behavior. One verified_web_authority helper checks configured live authority. Web merge-slot read/take/release use native holder/context; force-release and explicit repair need an owner/superuser, never an agent. Stale/repeated recovery preserves holder and audit; page and named client ship together. Host rules and independent approval remain. Older service without can_decide leaves newer page without an owner decision form. No web facts/integration writer or new store/switch.
